claims.evidence: View A: attention strongly on the upper location (almost certainly a green square). Recoverability of that upper item is ~0.22 now, ~0.16 after one step, ~0.12 after two steps.
Other A locations: right is almost certainly a red cross
left is almost certainly a blue circle.
View B: attention strongly on the left location (a red circle). Recoverability for that left item is ~0.51 now, ~0.37 after one step, ~0.27 after two steps.
Other B locations: upper is almost certainly a green triangle
right is almost certainly a yellow square
lower is almost certainly a blue cross (with some circle probability).
In A: a command "upper" will keep attention on the upper (green square)
"right" will move it to the right (red cross)
In B: most redirection commands are predicted to move attention to the lower location (blue cross).
Commands do not reliably select the currently attended left item.
